Aryan Rahman Portfolio

Click the button to download the complete project as one ZIP file. Unzip it, upload the contents to a GitHub repository, then deploy it on Netlify. Step-by-step instructions are inside the ZIP (SETUP.md).

    Admin login: the dashboard at /admin signs in with an email address and password through Netlify Identity. Invite your email in Netlify and set your password there. No password is stored in the project files because the repository and /admin page are public.
